pages.text: Jingle! The door opened just a little. A tiny child came halfway through the gap.
This was a little customer they hadn't seen before. Today Coco was greeting customers.
The child stood with lips pressed shut, unable to say what they wanted to buy.
Mr. Pig stepped forward. "I'll choose for you. Big bread is best!"
He put the biggest loaf in the child's arms. It hid the child's whole face.
The child shook their head. He added an even bigger loaf. "Then this too!"
Buried under two loaves, the child wobbled. Only their eyes peeped out.
Coco took back the two big loaves. Then Coco pointed to the bread one by one. Round bread, long bread, snail bread...
At the snail bread, the child's eyes sparkled. Coco grinned and picked it up.
The child hugged the bread and smiled for the first time on the way out. Mr. Pig tilted his head. "How did you know? They didn't say a word!"
